subject.title: refactor(tests): consolidate CLI command surface fixtures

question: Should this protected, eight-file CLI test-fixture consolidation proceed after the branch is refreshed against current `main` and its exact focused test evidence is made inspectable?
rationale: The `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, and the present review could not independently inspect the full changed modules, matching maintainer notes, or current-main history needed to certify semantic equivalence across the extracted fixtures.

options.title: Refresh and approve
options.body: Rebase onto current `main`, provide a redacted focused test transcript for the eight files, and approve if helper defaults preserve every exceptional mock path.

options.title: Split by test domain
options.body: Separate the broad refactor into smaller CLI, plugin, gateway, and model-test PRs if reviewing the combined fixture changes remains difficult.

options.title: Pause the consolidation
options.body: Close or defer the refactor if the test-speed gain does not justify the review cost of touching several ownership-sensitive command surfaces.

recommendation.title: Refresh and approve
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current `main`, provide a redacted focused test transcript for the eight files, and approve if helper defaults preserve every exceptional mock path.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the sole proposed refactor and supplied the stated validation evidence; current-main ownership provenance could not be independently collected.
